direct: Audit these AGENTS.md files for mechanically provable drift.
indirect: Check whether documented commands and paths still exist, then propose corrections.
incomplete: Audit every document on the machine without bounded roots or depth.
negative: Rewrite this documentation to sound more polished.
failure: A suspected stale command cannot be reproduced immediately before proposal time.

expected.output: Human-gated proposals backed by replayable failing checks.
expected.stop: Never widen the scan or edit audited guidance during the sweep.
